title: Assets
description: Equipment, fleet, maintenance, and operational stock.

assets.title: No assets yet
assets.body: Track equipment and vehicles, then log maintenance as operational notes.

fleet.title: No fleet vehicles yet
fleet.body: Link plate, VIN and odometer to vehicle assets.

maintenance.title: No maintenance records yet
maintenance.body: Log planned and completed service on asset detail pages. Overdue and upcoming lists appear here.

inventory.title: No inventory items yet
inventory.body: Track on-hand quantities. Receive and issue movements update stock only — not the ledger.

createAsset.title: New asset
createAsset.description: Add equipment or a vehicle. Fleet details are optional.

fleet.title: Fleet
fleet.description: Plate, VIN, and odometer for linked vehicles.
fleet.schemaLimitsBody: Ownership, lease, and driver tracking are not available yet. Project assignment uses the linked asset. Mileage is odometer only.
fleet.schemaLimitsDetails: Ownership/rental, lease, and driver/employee fields are not available yet. Project check-out uses the asset’s assigned project.

schedule.title: Maintenance schedule
schedule.emptyUpcoming: No upcoming maintenance in the next 30 days.
schedule.hint: Derived from planned/in-progress status and performed-on date. No notifications are sent.

detail.assignmentHint: Assign to a project to check out; clear to check in.
detail.historyHint: Chronological maintenance records for this asset.
detail.maintenanceHint: Cost here is operational metadata only and does not create an expense.
detail.costNotExpense: Not an Expense — cost is metadata only. No expense posting or ledger link.
detail.createLinkedExpenseHint: To affect Actual, explicitly create a linked expense draft — then finalize it in Expenses.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.description: On-hand quantities for materials and stock. Movements update quantity only — never GL or expense.
inventory.detailDescription: Operational stock only. Recording a movement does not create an expense or ledger entry.
inventory.movementNotExpense: Stock movements change on-hand quantity only. They are not expenses and do not post to the ledger.
inventory.adjustQuantityHint: For adjustments, enter a signed delta (for example 2 or -1).
inventory.historyHint: Chronological stock movements for this item. Quantity changes only — no financial posting.

errors.insufficientQuantity: Not enough quantity on hand for this issue.
errors.invalidMaintenanceTransition: That maintenance status change is not allowed.
errors.fleetRequiresVehicle: Fleet records must link to a vehicle asset.
errors.fleetAlreadyLinked: This vehicle already has a fleet record.
errors.fleetKindLocked: Remove the fleet record before changing this asset away from vehicle.

financeLink.hint: Creates an Expense draft only. Actual changes after you finalize the expense — not from this operational record alone.
financeLink.allocationHint: When set, uses the existing overhead allocation engine (contract weight / annual). Still draft until finalized.

errors.alreadyLinked: This record already has a linked expense.
errors.amountRequired: Amount is required to create a linked expense.
errors.currencyRequired: Currency is required to create a linked expense.
errors.inventoryNotExpense: Inventory movements cannot create linked expenses.
errors.unsupportedKind: This operational record type cannot link to expenses.
errors.mustBeDraft: Linked expenses must be created as drafts.
errors.notLinked: Expense is not linked to an operational record.
